title: Currency-safe grouping and page subtotals for dynamic purchase orders
description: A purchasing user groups the selected report page by supplier or month and sees order count and original-currency amount subtotals. Reuse ERP-125 authorization and bounded preview, preserve selected field order, reject unknown grouping before data access, and never claim payable balance or combine currencies. Existing HTTP operation audit records read-only requests. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify unit tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts only none/supplier/month grouping and computes count and amount subtotals from the same authorized bounded preview page; currencies never combine.
Designer offers finite grouping choices and labels subtotals as page-only in original currency, including empty groups and pagination changes.
Tests cover mixed currencies, month boundaries, selected fields, empty page, invalid group key, permission and no writes; document subtotal semantics.
